name: Little Lionfish 48
author: OptX71285225
description: Green checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #fff to #ccc, box-shadow becomes 0 0 10px #000000, transform becomes scale(1.05). Clicking it toggles it: starts the checkboxExpand animation (pulsing, rotating, sliding), background-color changes from #fff to #4caf50, border-color becomes #4caf50.
